_comment: Cloudreach grounding pass (owner 31 Oct 2026: big cylinders that don't touch the ground). scripts/world/cloudreach_grounding.gd seats every upright CylinderMesh whose base floats above the walkable ground under its rim with a flared skirt in its own material (sunk sink_m below the lowest ground point) and, for drums of rock_ring_min_radius_m or more, a ring of installed Rock_Medium pieces. Visual only: no collider, surface, route or creature changes. ON (owner 1 Nov: objective defect fix, proven by the report proof, ralph/reports/CLOUDREACH-LOOK/grounding_proof.json); also extrudes every hanging procedural rock drum (_mesa StratifiedCliffBody) down to the lowest ground under its outline, skipping drums mostly over open sky or over a road. Preview off-main with --cloudreach-grounding-candidate, list measurements with --cloudreach-grounding-report.
_skip_grounded_cloud_cards_note: NOT FOR LANDING (1 Nov regression: also removes good cumulus banks behind the Sky Shrine and Realm Gate plateaus, and the owner-stand card is transparent where the roof showed). Owner floating-drum stand (16.5, 4313.2): a triangle ray probe names the overhead drum as a 298 x 149 m installed cumulus card from a settlement cloud ring (cloudreach_settlement_life.gd _cloud_ring) standing in the UpperPlateauCircuit meadow, shaded dark. On: scripts/world/cloudreach_grounding.gd hides, after every builder, each ring card whose footprint has walkable ground between its bottom edge minus cloud_card_clear_m and its top plus cloud_card_clear_m. Preview --cloudreach-cloudcards-candidate.
_skip_floating_shelves_note: Owner floating-drum stand vegetatedgeolog12_1 (16.5, 4313.2): the overhead drum is a VegetatedGeologicalShelf on a rock shoulder hanging 8 m over the UpperPlateauCircuit meadow route; the grounding pass leaves it (route below). On: scripts/world/cloudreach_grounding.gd (after every builder) hides each rock-shoulder wall shelf or 12 m+ rock outcrop whose underside hangs between walker headroom and shelf_float_clear_m above walkable ground, with its colliders disabled and the tree on its top hidden. Preview --cloudreach-shelves-candidate.
_clear_paved_grass_note: P2-025 (tb/vis-water-sky, flag-off): grass tufts show through the Sky Shrine dais and other paved masonry tops (CPU and GPU frames). On: scripts/world/cloudreach_paved_grass.gd collapses every tuft instance standing on, or poking up through, a level masonry/path box top. Visual only.
